  PROBLEM: The `switches` array lists `STABLE_ROLLBACK_ENABLED` twice: the complete entry added by the last autofix run at lines 710-715 (with on_values ["1","yes","on"]) and an outdated #9359 placeholder at lines 1007-1011 that came in from main in merge commit 75453e66.
  WHY: tests/test_stage_switch_registry.py:150 (`assert len(names) == len(set(names))`) fails with `AssertionError: assert 208 == 207` in tests-system-python (run 45753130307), which fails the required `lint` aggregate job and blocks the merge; the two entries also give the switch two different descriptions, and only one has on_values. All five reviewers rated it BLOCKER (shown here as critical). The suggested fix is to delete the placeholder at lines 1007-1011 and keep lines 710-715.

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "After a rollback, neither `auto-release-stable.yml` nor the `promote-main-to-stable.yml` cycle releases until a release is cut deliberately."
  expected_change_site: the `promote` job of .github/workflows/promote-main-to-stable.yml, and the `target_sha` promote dispatch in scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: Neither file has a hunk in the PR diff, so the `promote` run the poller dispatches never reads the stable hold. promote-main-to-stable.yml has no reference to stable_hold, stable-hold.json or ai/stable-hold. The poller dispatches with `target_sha` (`scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:17440`), and the `promote` job fast-forwards `stable` (`.github/workflows/promote-main-to-stable.yml:205-218, 258-313`) without checking the rollback hold. agents.d/9342-stable-rollback.md and the README section "Roll back @stable" document this as a residual, with removing ai:comprehensive-test-pending by hand as the workaround. Severity disagreement: sonnet rated it NIT (it was deferred in earlier rounds as merge_with_followup and is not new in this run). Gemini, minimax and luna rated it MAJOR. Minimax and luna say the issue does not defer this requirement. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash treated it as explicitly deferred and reported no gap.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "After a rollback, neither auto-release-stable.yml nor the promote-main-to-stable.yml cycle releases until a release is cut deliberately. The release job clears the hold when it publishes." (Issue #9342 §Approach and §Goals; the exception list names test-and-mark-stable.yml and mark-stable.yml, not promote-main-to-stable.yml.)
  Expected change site: the promote job of .github/workflows/promote-main-to-stable.yml (lines 155 onward, the target_sha dispatch from scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh). It must read scripts/stable_hold.sh and skip the fast-forward and release gate when the hold is active or unknown.

The residual is acknowledged in agents.d/9342-stable-rollback.md and the README, with a manual removal of the ai:comprehensive-test-pending label as the workaround, and the plan grant's carve-out does not cover the poller-dispatched promote. Without the gate, a surviving ai:comprehensive-test-pending tracking issue gets promoted: the run fast-forwards stable, runs the release gate, clears the hold, and re-ships the regression. The fix is small but spans files outside the plan grant.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
